items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Max Jones and Arthur Albert McCartney were interested in that. They asked me when those records were made, see?

ctx.x: Is that listed in the discography? Let's take a look at that.

I've heard that discography, whatever there is on... What? On Jefferson? On Jefferson's Jazzman records. And a little odd thing about it, I... Max Jones and Arthur Albert McCartney were interested in that. They asked me when those records were made, see? The dates. All that information that I don't give much weight to myself, as long as it's good music. And so I went around to see Dave Tate about it, and he was flabbergasted. He's the man that recorded them. I asked him what date. He said, well, he couldn't give…
Dave Tate. Dave Tate. Tate. Of the U.S. Recording Studio.
